🎙 Minab school bombing targeted foundations of morality, humanity: Judiciary spokesperson

📌 Bandar Abbas, IRNA – Judiciary spokesperson Ali Kazemi has condemned the US-Israeli bombing of Shajareh Tayyebeh School in Minab, southern Iran, describing it as more than a military crime and saying it targeted the foundations of morality and humanity in the international community.

Speaking at a press conference in Minab on Tuesday, Kazemi said turning moments of joy into mourning had become a recurring pattern and a blatant, systematic violation of human rights, with similar incidents reported in countries such as Afghanistan and Iraq.
​
He said children represented the future of humanity, adding that every child buried under the rubble represented a part of the future of the global community being buried as well.
​
“These children had no particular connection to political disputes and were not fighting or at war with anyone,” Kazemi said, stressing the need to pay serious attention to the physical and psychological suffering inflicted on the children and their families.
​
The Judiciary spokesperson said a case concerning the deaths and injuries of students, parents and teachers at the Shajareh Tayyebeh Elementary School had been opened from the earliest hours following the attack on February 28.
​
He said the case had been transferred to Tehran after preliminary investigations in Hormuzgan Province, adding that an indictment was issued last month and the case is now being heard by the Islamic Revolution Court in the capital city.
​
Kazemi also said a civil case had been filed at a Tehran court to pursue compensation for the material and moral damages suffered by the victims and their families.
​
He said, in cooperation with the government and the Foreign Ministry, an official United Nations document had also been issued concerning the Minab attack, which would be used in international legal efforts.
​
According to Kazemi, the document confirms that the site of the attack was an educational facility rather than a military location and that the attack was not treated as an accident or mistake.

📲 @Irna_en​

📡 Enemy repeated Ba’athists’ miscalculation: Amoli Larijani

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Chairman of Iran’s Expediency Council Ayatollah Sadeq Amoli Larijani says the United States and Israeli regime repeated the same “miscalculation” made by former Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein and his supporters by believing that military action against Iran would quickly achieve their objectives.

In a message posted on his X account on Tuesday, Amoli Larijani said the major lesson of Iran’s eight-year Sacred Defense was that Saddam and his international and regional supporters had assumed that the military structure of the newly established Islamic Revolution would collapse within days and the Ba’athist army would reach the gates of Tehran.
​
Backed by the United States and European powers, Saddam Hussein waged a war of aggression against the Islamic Republic on September 22, 1980, less than two years after the Islamic Revolution in Iran.
​
“What nullified this calculation was the presence and sacrifice of all sections of the people on the fronts,” Amoli Larijani said.
​
He said the same mistake has now been repeated by the “criminal and corrupt leaders” of Israel and the United States, who mistakenly believed that “by assassination and war crimes against the Islamic Republic of Iran, the job would be finished in a short time.”
​
Amoli Larijani said the resistance of the Iranian people and those who remained on the battlefield left the perpetrators “in bewilderment and humiliation.”
​
“Anyone who leaves the will of this nation out of their calculations will have no fate other than that of the Ba’athists,” he said.
